claims.source_quote_ar: كما يقول الغالب للمغلوب في جدال أو صراع أو غيرهما.
claims.claim_ar: أسلوب الآية يُشبه خطابَ الغالب للمغلوب في مجادلة — تعريض وتحدٍّ يُلزِم الخصم بالإقرار.
claims.claim_en: The verse's style resembles the victor addressing the vanquished in debate — a challenging, triumphal address that compels the opponent's admission.
claims.rhetorical_effect: forces moral/legal admission by portraying the speaker as victor; increases rhetorical pressure on the opponent to concede

claims.claim_ar: فعل الأمر «تَعَالَوْا» يعمل كدعوة إنشائية لإجراء لقاء/قَصْدٍ مشترك (ندعُ) ليُبَيِّنَ كلٌّ حُجّته؛ أي: دعوة إلى إثبات الحجة عملاً لا كلاماً.
claims.claim_en: The imperative 'تَعَالَوْا' functions as an invitational/constructive injunction — calling both parties to a joint action (oath/invocation) to present and test their claims.
claims.rhetorical_effect: turns dispute from mere argument into a public, decisive act; heightens seriousness and stakes

claims.source_quote_ar: سَواءٍ بَيْنَنا وَبَيْنَكُمْ مستوية بيننا وبينكم
claims.claim_ar: التوازي «أَبْنَاءَنَا وَأَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَنِسَاءَنَا وَنِسَاءَكُمْ وَأَنْفُسَنَا وَأَنْفُسَكُمْ» يحقق مِقابَلة ومُحاكاة بين الطرفين، والتقرير في التفسير يؤكد التسوية (السَّواء) بين الطرفين.
claims.claim_en: The parallel listing (our sons and your sons; our women and your women; our selves and your selves) creates a mirroring (muqābalah) between the parties; the commentary explicitly stresses equality ('sawāʾ') between them.
claims.needs_review_reason: The commentary explicitly states equality (سَواء) but the rhetorical-tag 'muqabalah' is an interpretive identification of the mirrored structure rather than an explicit label in the chunk.
claims.rhetorical_effect: emphasizes parity of status/responsibility between the groups; reinforces fairness of the mutual test and undercuts claims to special superiority

Some rhetorical attributions (e.g., labeling the coordinated list as 'muqabalah') are interpretive readings supported by commentary language (e.g., 'سَواءٍ ...') rather than explicit rhetorical terminology in the chunks; such inferences are marked with lower confidence/needs_review reasons.
